home.props.0.body.message: Your booking page shows your services and open times, takes a deposit if you want one, and can sit on your own website.

home.solutionsIntro.lede.message: The same app runs a grooming salon, a cleaning business and a tutoring studio. Each one starts from services, booking rules and forms that suit the trade.

home.features.0.title.message: A calendar that knows your services and your staff.

home.features.1.title.message: Send an invoice from the booking, and see when it is paid.

home.features.1.body.message: Invoices pick up the services from the visit, add the right tax, and go out with a link the client can pay from. Estimates turn into invoices when the client accepts them, and overdue invoices are easy to spot.

home.features.1.points.0.message: Card payment from a link on every invoice

home.features.1.points.1.message: Partial payments, refunds and credit notes

home.features.2.title.message: Take a card at the counter with the phone you already have.

home.features.2.body.message: Tap to Pay turns an iPhone or Android phone into a card reader, so you can charge for a visit or sell a product without extra hardware. The sale is recorded against the client and the tax is included.

home.features.2.points.0.message: Tap to Pay on iPhone and Android

home.features.2.points.2.message: Schedule and client list available offline

home.features.3.body.message: Shampoo, brushes, supplements or styling products sit in the same catalog as your services, with a SKU, a cost and a stock count if you want one. Ring them up on the same ticket as a visit, or let clients order from your shop page and pick up.

home.features.3.points.0.message: Stock counts drop as you sell, with a low-stock list and restock

home.features.3.points.2.message: Itemised receipts by text, and sales by item for your bookkeeper

home.features.4.title.message: Booking and payment pages with your name on them.

home.payments.title.message: The money goes to your bank, and the records keep themselves.

home.payments.steps.2.body.message: Your payments balance is paid out to your bank account. Each payout lists the payments, fees and refunds it covers.

home.payments.steps.3.body.message: The GST/HST you collected is tracked by period, with a return report ready to export and mark as filed.

home.included.title.message: The rest of the business, in the same app.

home.included.items.4.body.message: Optional stock counts per product, a low-stock list, and restock in a tap.

home.included.items.5.body.message: Clients add a product when they book, and it is added to the visit's invoice.

home.included.items.6.body.message: Roles for owners and staff, earnings on completed work, and pay records.

home.included.items.7.body.message: A commission rate per staff member, recorded on each sale they make.

home.included.items.8.body.message: Two-way texts with clients, kept in one inbox per client.

home.included.items.10.body.message: The schedule and client list stay on your device and sync when you reconnect.

home.included.items.11.body.message: Income, GST/HST and T4A reports, exported as CSV for your bookkeeper.

pages.pricingPage.faq.0.q.message: Can I try it before I pay?

pages.pricingPage.faq.0.a.message: Yes. Every business starts with a 14-day free trial and no card is needed. You can also look around a demo business that already has a full week of bookings, invoices and payments.

pages.pricingPage.faq.1.a.message: Your business has its own payments account. Card payments are paid out to your bank on a regular schedule.

pages.pricingPage.faq.2.q.message: Can I record payments taken outside the app?

pages.pricingPage.faq.2.a.message: Yes. Cash, cheques and other payments you receive directly are recorded on the invoice, so its balance and your reports stay correct.

pages.pricingPage.faq.3.a.message: Yes. GST, HST, PST and QST are worked out for your province on every invoice line, and the tax you collected is tracked by period with a report ready for your return.

pages.pricingPage.faq.4.q.message: Do my staff need their own login?

pages.pricingPage.faq.4.a.message: Each staff member gets their own login with the right role. Staff see their own schedule and clients, and owners and admins see the money.

pages.pricingPage.faq.5.q.message: Does it work on my phone?

pages.pricingPage.faq.5.a.message: Yes. There is a web app and apps for iPhone and Android. The schedule and client list stay on your device, so they are there even when the connection drops.

pages.pricingPage.faq.6.q.message: Can clients book from my own website?

pages.pricingPage.faq.6.a.message: Yes. Your booking page has its own link, and it can be embedded on your existing website with a short snippet.

pages.pricingPage.faq.7.q.message: What happens when the trial ends?

pages.pricingPage.faq.7.a.message: Choose Premium or Team, paid monthly or yearly, to keep working as before. If you don't, your business becomes read-only: you can still sign in, see your records and get paid for invoices you already sent, and your data is kept.

pages.pricingPage.faq.8.q.message: Is tax added to the plan price?

pages.pricingPage.faq.8.a.message: Plan prices are before tax. GST or HST, plus QST in Quebec, is added at checkout and shown on each plan invoice.

pages.privacyPage.meta.description.message: How Clientbridge collects, uses and protects personal information.

pages.privacyPage.intro.message: This policy explains how ClientBridge Inc. collects, uses, discloses and protects personal information when you use Clientbridge, our website at clientbridge.ca, and the booking, payment and shop pages that businesses share with their clients.

pages.privacyPage.sections.0.title.message: Who we are and what this policy covers

pages.privacyPage.sections.0.body.0.message: ClientBridge Inc. ("ClientBridge", "we", "us") is a corporation based in Ontario, Canada. We provide Clientbridge, software that service businesses use to take bookings, sell services and products, send invoices and estimates, accept payments and keep client records, on the web and in the iPhone and Android apps.

pages.privacyPage.sections.0.body.1.message: This policy covers two kinds of personal information. The first is information about you when you visit our website, join our waitlist, or sign up for and use Clientbridge on behalf of a business. We decide how that information is used and are responsible for it.

pages.privacyPage.sections.0.body.2.message: The second is information that a business using Clientbridge keeps about its own clients, such as names, contact details, the pets or other subjects of a booking, appointments, purchases, payments, forms, contracts, messages and notes. The business decides what it collects and how it uses it, and we process that information on the business's behalf to provide the service. If you are a client of a business that uses Clientbridge, the business's own privacy practices apply, and requests to see, correct or delete that information should go to the business first. We help businesses respond to those requests.

pages.privacyPage.sections.1.body.0.message: We collect only the information we need to provide, secure and support Clientbridge:

pages.privacyPage.sections.1.items.0.message: Account information: your name, email address and phone number, your password (stored only as a one-way hash) or the Google account you sign in with, and your role in the business.

pages.privacyPage.sections.1.items.1.message: Business information: the business's name, address, time zone, services, hours, staff, tax registrations, branding and plan.

pages.privacyPage.sections.1.items.2.message: Payment and payout information: when a business sets up payments, Stripe collects the identity, bank and tax details it requires. We receive the status of the account and the details needed to show payments and payouts, not full card or bank account numbers.

pages.privacyPage.sections.1.items.3.message: Client information that a business enters, or that its clients submit through booking, payment, shop, form and contract pages.

pages.privacyPage.sections.1.items.4.message: Messages: texts sent to clients, platform emails and push notifications to account holders, with their delivery status, and replies that clients send to a business's text number.

pages.privacyPage.sections.1.items.5.message: Device and usage information: the IP address, browser or device type, app version and time of each request, which our servers record to keep the service secure and working, and a device token for push notifications if you allow them in the mobile apps.

pages.privacyPage.sections.1.items.6.message: Waitlist information: the email address you give us when you join the waitlist.

pages.privacyPage.sections.2.body.0.message: We use personal information for the following purposes:

pages.privacyPage.sections.2.items.0.message: To provide Clientbridge: to run accounts, show schedules and records, handle bookings, sales and invoices, text clients, and send account emails and notifications.

pages.privacyPage.sections.2.items.1.message: To process payments, refunds, payouts and plan subscriptions through Stripe.

pages.privacyPage.sections.2.items.2.message: To keep the service secure: to verify sign-ins, prevent fraud and abuse, and investigate problems.

pages.privacyPage.sections.2.items.3.message: To answer you when you contact us for help.

pages.privacyPage.sections.2.items.4.message: To send service messages, such as receipts, security notices, trial and billing reminders, and notice of changes to our terms or this policy.

pages.privacyPage.sections.2.items.5.message: To tell waitlist members when Clientbridge opens. Every such email has an unsubscribe link.

pages.privacyPage.sections.2.items.6.message: To meet our legal, tax and accounting obligations.

pages.privacyPage.sections.3.body.0.message: We collect, use and disclose personal information with your consent. Consent may be express, for example when you join the waitlist or turn on push notifications, or implied by your use of a feature for the purpose it serves. You can withdraw your consent at any time, subject to legal or contractual limits, although some features may then stop working.

pages.privacyPage.sections.3.body.1.message: A business that uses Clientbridge is responsible for having the consent it needs from its clients, including consent to receive commercial texts under Canada's Anti-Spam Legislation.

pages.privacyPage.sections.3.body.2.message: We do not sell personal information, and we do not use a business's client information for our own marketing.

pages.privacyPage.sections.4.body.0.message: We share personal information only with the service providers that help us run Clientbridge, under contracts that limit their use of it to the services they provide to us:

pages.privacyPage.sections.4.items.0.message: Google Cloud, for hosting, databases and file storage.

pages.privacyPage.sections.4.items.1.message: Stripe, for payment processing, payouts and plan billing. Stripe is responsible for the information it collects as a payment provider, as described under Payment services above.

pages.privacyPage.sections.4.items.3.message: Twilio, for sending and receiving text messages.

pages.privacyPage.sections.4.items.4.message: Expo, for delivering push notifications to the mobile apps.

pages.privacyPage.sections.4.items.5.message: Google, for sign-in when you choose to sign in with a Google account.

pages.privacyPage.sections.4.items.6.message: Render, for hosting our website and waitlist.

pages.privacyPage.sections.5.body.0.message: We may also disclose personal information when the law requires it, to protect the rights, safety or property of our users, ClientBridge or others, or as part of a merger, financing or sale of all or part of our business. In a sale or merger, the information stays subject to the protections in this policy.

pages.privacyPage.sections.6.body.0.message: Clientbridge stores its data with Google Cloud in the United States, and some of our service providers process information in the United States and other countries. Information held outside Canada is subject to the laws of the country where it is held, and may be accessible to that country's courts, law enforcement and national security authorities. We choose providers that protect personal information to a standard comparable to the one required in Canada.

pages.privacyPage.sections.7.body.0.message: We keep account and business information while the account is open. When a business's trial or plan ends without a new plan, its records stay available read-only, so it can still see them and get paid for invoices it already sent.

pages.privacyPage.sections.7.body.1.message: When a business asks us to close its account, we delete or anonymize its information, including its clients' information, within 90 days, except for records we must keep longer to meet legal, tax or accounting obligations, such as our own billing records. Database backups are kept for 7 days and earlier versions of stored files for 30 days, after which they are overwritten.

pages.privacyPage.sections.7.body.2.message: We keep a waitlist email address until Clientbridge opens and we have told you, or until you unsubscribe or ask us to delete it.

pages.privacyPage.sections.8.body.0.message: We protect personal information with safeguards suited to its sensitivity: encrypted connections, encryption of stored data, access limited to the people and systems that need it, separate database permissions for each part of the service, and a record of sensitive changes such as payments and refunds. Card numbers are entered into Stripe's own payment fields and never reach our servers.

pages.privacyPage.sections.8.body.1.message: No system is completely secure. If a breach of our security safeguards creates a real risk of significant harm to anyone, we will notify the people affected and the Privacy Commissioner of Canada, and the privacy commissioner of a province where the law requires it.

pages.privacyPage.sections.9.body.0.message: You can ask to see the personal information we hold about you, to correct it, or to have it deleted, and you can ask how it has been used and to whom it has been disclosed. Residents of Quebec can also ask to receive their information in a structured, commonly used technological format. Many details can be changed directly in the app. We respond to requests within 30 days, and we may first need to confirm your identity.

pages.privacyPage.sections.9.body.1.message: If you are not satisfied with our answer, you can complain to the Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada, or to the privacy regulator of your province: the Office of the Information and Privacy Commissioner for British Columbia, the Office of the Information and Privacy Commissioner of Alberta, or the Commission d'accès à l'information du Québec.

pages.privacyPage.sections.10.body.0.message: Our website does not use cookies. The Clientbridge web app uses cookies only to keep you signed in and to protect its sign-in forms, and the mobile apps keep your session in the device's secure storage. Pages that take payments load Stripe's payment fields, which may set cookies that Stripe uses to prevent fraud. We do not use cookies or other trackers for advertising or third-party analytics.

pages.privacyPage.sections.11.body.0.message: Clientbridge is a service for businesses and is not directed at children. Account holders must have reached the age of majority where they live. A business may keep information about a child who is its client, such as a student, and is responsible for having the consent of a parent or guardian.

pages.privacyPage.sections.12.body.0.message: We may update this policy as Clientbridge changes. We will post the new version on this page with its date, and if a change is significant we will tell account holders by email or in the app before it takes effect.

pages.privacyPage.contact.message: Our privacy officer is responsible for this policy. You can reach them at {email}, or by mail at {address}.

pages.termsPage.meta.description.message: The terms that apply to using Clientbridge.

pages.termsPage.intro.message: These terms set out the rules for using Clientbridge, for the businesses that use it and for their clients who use its booking, payment and shop pages. Please read them with our privacy policy.

pages.termsPage.sections.0.body.0.message: These terms are an agreement between ClientBridge Inc. ("ClientBridge", "we", "us") and the business or person that creates a Clientbridge account ("you"). By creating an account or using Clientbridge, you agree to them. If you accept them on behalf of a business, you confirm that you have the authority to bind it.

pages.termsPage.sections.0.body.1.message: Clients of a business who use its booking, payment, shop, form or contract pages do so under the section of these terms written for them. Their agreement for the services and products they buy is with the business, not with ClientBridge.

pages.termsPage.sections.1.body.0.message: Clientbridge is software for running a service business: online booking, client records, sales, invoices and estimates, payments, sales tax, staff and pay, messages, forms and contracts, on the web and in the iPhone and Android apps. Some features depend on the plan you choose and on third-party services such as Stripe.

pages.termsPage.sections.1.body.1.message: Clientbridge helps you keep records and work out amounts such as sales tax and staff pay, but it does not give legal, tax or accounting advice. You are responsible for checking the figures you file or rely on.

pages.termsPage.sections.2.body.0.message: You must have reached the age of majority where you live, and you must give accurate information when you sign up. You are responsible for keeping your sign-in details secure, for everything done under your account, and for the staff you invite and the roles you give them. Tell us promptly if you think your account has been used without your permission.

pages.termsPage.sections.3.body.0.message: Every business starts with a 14-day free trial, and no card is needed for it. To keep using Clientbridge after the trial, you choose a paid plan, billed monthly or yearly in advance through Stripe. Prices are in Canadian dollars and do not include sales tax, which is added where it applies. On the Premium plan, each additional staff seat is billed with the plan.

pages.termsPage.sections.3.body.1.message: Plans renew automatically until you cancel. You can change or cancel your plan at any time from the app. A cancellation takes effect at the end of the period you have paid for, and amounts already paid are not refunded, except where the law requires it.

pages.termsPage.sections.3.body.2.message: If you do not choose a plan when your trial ends, or a plan payment fails and is not resolved, your business becomes read-only: you can still sign in, see your records and get paid for invoices you already sent, and your data is kept.

pages.termsPage.sections.3.body.3.message: We may change our prices. We will tell you at least 30 days before a change applies to your plan, and it applies from your next billing period.

pages.termsPage.sections.4.body.0.message: To take payments from your clients, you connect a Stripe account. Payment processing is provided by Stripe under the Stripe Connected Account Agreement, which you accept when you connect, and Stripe, not ClientBridge, holds and pays out your funds. You authorize us to share information with Stripe and to create charges, refunds and payouts on your account as you instruct through Clientbridge.

pages.termsPage.sections.4.body.1.message: Payments carry the fees shown on our pricing page, which combine Stripe's processing fee and the Clientbridge fee and are deducted from each payment. You are responsible for refunds, disputes and chargebacks on payments to your business, including their fees, and for honouring your own cancellation and refund policies.

pages.termsPage.sections.5.body.0.message: You are responsible for the services and products you sell, for the prices, taxes and policies you set, and for your dealings with your clients. You are responsible for collecting, reporting and remitting the sales taxes on your sales.

pages.termsPage.sections.5.body.1.message: You must collect and use your clients' personal information lawfully and with the consent it requires, and send commercial emails and texts only to clients who have agreed to receive them, as Canada's Anti-Spam Legislation requires.

pages.termsPage.sections.6.body.0.message: You agree not to use Clientbridge to:

pages.termsPage.sections.6.items.0.message: break the law or infringe anyone's rights;

pages.termsPage.sections.6.items.1.message: sell goods or services that the law or Stripe's list of restricted businesses prohibits;

pages.termsPage.sections.6.items.2.message: send messages to people who have not agreed to receive them;

pages.termsPage.sections.6.items.3.message: upload malicious code, or content you do not have the right to use;

pages.termsPage.sections.6.items.4.message: access accounts or systems that are not yours, or probe, disrupt or overload the service;

pages.termsPage.sections.6.items.5.message: copy, resell or reverse engineer Clientbridge, except where the law allows it.

pages.termsPage.sections.7.body.0.message: We may remove content or suspend an account that breaks these terms. We will tell you why, unless the law or the safety of others prevents it.

pages.termsPage.sections.8.body.0.message: You keep all rights to the information you and your clients put into Clientbridge. You give us permission to host, copy, process and display it only as needed to provide, secure and support the service for you. We handle the personal information in it as our privacy policy describes, acting on your behalf for your clients' information.

pages.termsPage.sections.8.body.1.message: You can ask us for a copy of your data at any time while your account is open, and for 90 days after it closes.

pages.termsPage.sections.9.body.0.message: Clientbridge, including its software, design and name, belongs to ClientBridge Inc. and its licensors. These terms give you a limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable right to use Clientbridge for your business while your account is in good standing. If you send us suggestions, we may use them without any obligation to you.

pages.termsPage.sections.10.body.0.message: We work to keep Clientbridge available and to protect your data with regular backups, but we do not promise that it will be free of interruptions or errors. We may change, add or remove features. If we remove a feature that your paid plan includes in a way that significantly reduces the plan, we will tell you in advance.

pages.termsPage.sections.11.body.0.message: If you use a booking, payment, shop, form or contract page as a client of a business, the business is responsible for its services, prices, cancellation and refund policies, and for how it uses your information. Payments you make are processed by Stripe on the business's behalf. Questions about a booking, a charge or a refund should go to the business first. You agree to give accurate information and not to misuse these pages.

pages.termsPage.sections.12.body.0.message: You can close your account at any time by contacting us. Closing it cancels your plan at the end of the period you have paid for. We may suspend or close an account that seriously or repeatedly breaks these terms, that does not pay what it owes, or that we are required by law to close, and we will give notice where we reasonably can.

pages.termsPage.sections.12.body.1.message: The sections on your data, intellectual property, liability and governing law continue to apply after an account ends.

pages.termsPage.sections.13.body.0.message: Clientbridge is provided "as is" and "as available". To the extent the law allows, we disclaim all warranties and conditions that these terms do not state, including those of merchantable quality, fitness for a particular purpose and non-infringement.

pages.termsPage.sections.13.body.1.message: To the extent the law allows, ClientBridge is not liable for indirect, incidental, special or consequential losses, or for lost profits, revenue or data, and our total liability for all claims relating to Clientbridge is limited to the amount you paid us in the 12 months before the claim arose.

pages.termsPage.sections.13.body.2.message: You agree to compensate ClientBridge for claims by third parties, including your clients, that arise from your services, your content or your breach of these terms.

pages.termsPage.sections.13.body.3.message: Nothing in these terms limits liability that the law does not allow to be limited, or the rights that consumers have under the consumer protection laws of their province.

pages.termsPage.sections.14.body.0.message: These terms are governed by the laws of Ontario and the federal laws of Canada that apply there, and the courts of Ontario have jurisdiction over any dispute about them. If you are a consumer in Quebec, British Columbia, Alberta or another province, you keep the protection of your province's consumer protection laws, including any right they give you to bring a claim in your own province.

pages.termsPage.sections.15.body.0.message: We may update these terms. We will post the new version on this page with its date and, for a significant change, tell account holders by email or in the app at least 30 days before it takes effect. If you keep using Clientbridge after that, the new terms apply. If you do not agree to them, you can cancel your plan before they take effect.

pages.termsPage.contact.message: Questions about these terms can be sent to {email}, or by mail to {address}.

solutions.solutionsMeta.description.message: How Clientbridge works for groomers, salons, trainers, cleaners, tutors, therapists, photographers and trades.

solutions.solutionsPage.title.message: One app, set up for the way each trade books, bills and gets paid.

solutions.solutionsPage.lede.message: A groomer needs each pet's notes on the booking, a cleaner needs the entry instructions for each home, and a photographer needs a signed contract before the date is held. Clientbridge handles each of these with the same bookings, invoices, payments and sales tax underneath.

solutions.solutionsPage.engineTitle.message: What every business gets, whatever the trade.

solutions.solutionsPage.engine.0.body.message: Services with their own length, price, buffer and deposit, staff hours, classes with a capacity, and recurring visits.

solutions.solutionsPage.engine.1.body.message: Built from the booking, numbered in order, and paid by card from a link.

solutions.solutionsPage.engine.2.body.message: Take a card in person on an iPhone or Android phone, with no separate card reader.

solutions.solutionsPage.engine.3.body.message: Worked out from your province on every line, tracked by period, and ready for your return.

solutions.solutionsPage.engine.4.body.message: Prepaid bundles that count down, monthly charges to a saved card or by pre-authorized debit, and gift cards.

solutions.solutionsPage.engine.5.body.message: Hours and services for each person, earnings on completed work, and T4A reports at year end.

solutions.solutionsPage.engine.6.body.message: Reminders by text, and two-way messages kept in one inbox per client.

solutions.solutionsPage.engine.7.body.message: Intake forms, waivers and contracts signed online, and a review request after each visit.

solutions.solutionsPage.engine.8.body.message: The schedule and client list stay on your device when the connection drops, and sync when it returns.

solutions.solutionsPage.closing.title.message: Your trade is not listed here.

solutions.solutionsPage.closing.lede.message: If you book appointments, send invoices and take payments in Canada, the same setup applies. Start with your services and hours, and the rest follows from there.

solutions.tradePage.note.message: Web, iPhone and Android. No card required to try it.

solutions.tradePage.closing.title.message: Set up your services and open your booking page today.

solutions.tradePage.closing.lede.message: Add your services, hours and staff, set up payments and payouts, and share your booking page. You can also open the demo business to look around first.

trades.pet-grooming.oneLine.message: Grooms, add-ons and daycare days, with each pet's notes on the booking.

trades.pet-grooming.h1.message: Grooming and daycare bookings, with the pet on every one.

trades.pet-grooming.lede.message: Each client record holds their pets, with breed, coat, temperament and notes from the last groom. Owners book a groom or a daycare day online, pay a deposit, and get a reminder the day before.

trades.pet-grooming.photo.alt.message: A groomer scissoring a Shih Tzu on a grooming table, with a poodle waiting behind

trades.pet-grooming.photo2.alt.message: A groomer brushing a Cocker Spaniel

trades.pet-grooming.bookings.title.message: A groom takes as long as the dog needs, and the calendar knows it.

trades.pet-grooming.bookings.body.message: Each service has its own length and a buffer after it, so a full groom on a doodle blocks enough time for drying and clean-up before the next dog. Daycare runs as a session with a capacity, so you take a set number of dogs per day and the booking page stops offering the day when it is full.

trades.pet-grooming.bookings.list.0.message: Pets stored on the client, with breed, weight and notes

trades.pet-grooming.bookings.list.1.message: Add-ons such as a nail grind or teeth brushing on the same booking

trades.pet-grooming.bookings.list.2.message: Daycare days with a daily capacity

trades.pet-grooming.bookings.list.3.message: Repeat grooms every four, six or eight weeks

trades.pet-grooming.capabilities.0.title.message: Deposits that come off the bill

trades.pet-grooming.capabilities.0.body.message: Take a fixed amount or a percentage when an owner books online. The deposit is applied to the invoice at pickup, so they only pay the balance.

trades.pet-grooming.capabilities.1.body.message: Sell a pack of ten daycare days that counts down as the dog attends, or a monthly membership charged to a saved card.

trades.pet-grooming.capabilities.2.body.message: The invoice is built from the booking and its add-ons. Send it by text, or take payment at the counter when the owner arrives.

trades.pet-grooming.capabilities.3.body.message: Charge a card with your phone at pickup, or send a payment link the client pays by card.

trades.pet-grooming.capabilities.4.body.message: Sell gift cards on your booking page or at the counter, and redeem them against any groom, daycare day or product.

trades.pet-grooming.capabilities.5.body.message: Each groomer has their own hours and services. Completed grooms are recorded as earnings, so pay records are ready at the end of the period.

trades.pet-grooming.capabilities.6.body.message: GST, HST, PST or QST is worked out from your province on every line, including shampoo you sell, and the period total is ready for your return.

trades.pet-grooming.capabilities.7.body.message: Reminders go out by text before each appointment, and you can tell the owner their dog is ready from the same inbox.

trades.pet-grooming.capabilities.8.body.message: Ask for vaccination dates and a signed grooming consent when a new client books, and keep both on their record.

trades.pet-grooming.capabilities.9.body.message: Save your Google review link to invite clients after completed appointments. Clients leave their reviews directly on Google.

trades.pet-grooming.capabilities.10.titl.message: Products, stock and an online shop

trades.pet-grooming.capabilities.10.body.message: Sell shampoo and brushes at the counter or from your shop page for pickup. Owners can add one when they book, and stock counts drop as you sell.

trades.pet-grooming.capabilities.11.body.message: The schedule and pet notes stay on your phone or tablet when the Wi-Fi drops, and changes sync when you reconnect.

trades.pet-grooming.pay.title.message: A groom, a nail grind and a shampoo, paid at pickup.

trades.pet-grooming.pay.body.message: The owner paid a $27.50 deposit and added a bottle of shampoo when they booked online. At pickup the invoice includes the shampoo, applies the deposit, adds the tax, and the owner taps their card on your phone for the balance.

trades.salons.oneLine.message: Booking by stylist, long colour appointments, and products on the same ticket.

trades.salons.h1.message: Stylists, colour appointments and products, run from one schedule.

trades.salons.lede.message: Clients book with the stylist they want, long colour appointments hold the chair for the right amount of time, and products are rung up on the same ticket as the cut.

trades.salons.photo.alt.message: A stylist trimming a client's hair beside a sunlit window

trades.salons.photo2.alt.message: A stylist with a client in a small salon

trades.salons.heroCard.detail.message: Full colour and blow-dry · Sat 10:00 with Dana

trades.salons.bookings.title.message: Each stylist has their own column, hours and services.

trades.salons.bookings.body.message: Clients choose a stylist on your booking page, or take the first one available. Each service carries its own length and clean-up time, so a full colour followed by a blow-dry fills the chair for exactly as long as it takes, and the next client is not squeezed.

trades.salons.bookings.list.0.message: Hours, days off and services for each stylist

trades.salons.bookings.list.2.message: Lash, brow and waxing services, each with its own length

trades.salons.bookings.list.3.message: Book the next visit before the client leaves

trades.salons.capabilities.0.body.message: Ask for a deposit on the services where a no-show costs you most. It is taken when the client books and applied to the final bill.

trades.salons.capabilities.1.body.message: Run a monthly blow-dry membership charged to a saved card, or sell a series of treatments that counts down with each visit.

trades.salons.capabilities.2.body.message: Add shampoo, styling products or tools to the client's ticket at checkout, with tax on every line and the sale recorded against the client.

trades.salons.capabilities.3.title.message: Tap to Pay at the front desk

trades.salons.capabilities.3.body.message: Take a card with an iPhone or Android phone at the desk, or send the client a link to pay by card.

trades.salons.capabilities.4.body.message: Sell gift cards at the front desk and on your booking page, and redeem them against any service or product.

trades.salons.capabilities.5.body.message: Each stylist's completed services are recorded as earnings, so commission and pay records are ready at the end of the period.

trades.salons.capabilities.6.body.message: Services and products in Ontario carry 13% HST. It is added to each line and tracked by period, ready for your return.

trades.salons.capabilities.7.body.message: Send a consultation or patch-test form before a first colour appointment, and keep the signed copy on the client's record.

trades.salons.capabilities.8.body.message: Reminders go out by text before each appointment. Replies and questions come back to one inbox per client.

trades.salons.capabilities.9.body.message: Save your Google review link to invite clients after completed appointments. Clients leave their reviews directly on Google.

trades.salons.capabilities.10.body.message: Track stock on the products you sell, see what is running low and restock. Each sale records a commission for the stylist who made it.

trades.salons.capabilities.11.title.message: Works when the Wi-Fi does not

trades.salons.capabilities.11.body.message: The day's schedule and client notes stay on the front desk tablet and your phone, and sync when the connection comes back.

trades.salons.pay.title.message: A cut, a gloss and a bottle of conditioner on one ticket.

trades.salons.pay.body.message: Services and products go on the same invoice, and Ontario HST is added to every line. The client pays by card at the desk, and the sale and the stylist's earnings are recorded together.

trades.fitness.oneLine.message: One-on-one sessions, classes with a set number of spots, packs and memberships.

trades.fitness.h1.message: Sessions, classes and memberships, with the billing handled.

trades.fitness.lede.message: One-on-one sessions, small group classes with a set number of spots, and monthly memberships run from the same calendar, and the card on file is charged on schedule.

trades.fitness.photo.alt.message: A personal trainer and a client reviewing a plan on a tablet in a small gym

trades.fitness.bookings.title.message: One-on-one or a class of twelve, on the same calendar.

trades.fitness.bookings.body.message: A personal training session books one client with one trainer. A class is a session with a capacity, so clients book spots until it is full and the booking page stops offering it. Clients who train at the same time each week are booked once and the session repeats.

trades.fitness.bookings.list.0.message: Classes with a capacity and a live spot count

trades.fitness.bookings.list.2.message: Session packs that count down as they are used

trades.fitness.bookings.list.3.message: Hours and services for each trainer

trades.fitness.capabilities.0.body.message: Charge a membership each month to a saved card or by pre-authorized debit. Memberships with a failed payment are flagged so you can follow up.

trades.fitness.capabilities.1.body.message: Sell a pack of ten sessions that counts down as they are booked, with an expiry date if you use one.

trades.fitness.capabilities.2.body.message: Take a deposit when a new client books an assessment, and it comes off the invoice for that session.

trades.fitness.capabilities.3.body.message: Every pack, membership charge and drop-in class has an invoice and a receipt sent by text.

trades.fitness.capabilities.4.title.message: Tap to Pay on the gym floor

trades.fitness.capabilities.4.body.message: Sell a pack or a drop-in class with Tap to Pay on your phone, or send a payment link by text.

trades.fitness.capabilities.5.body.message: Sell gift cards for sessions or classes online, and redeem them at checkout or against a pack.

trades.fitness.capabilities.6.body.message: Each trainer sets their hours and the sessions they run. Completed sessions are recorded as earnings for their pay.

trades.fitness.capabilities.7.body.message: In Quebec, training sessions and memberships carry GST and QST. Both are calculated on every line and tracked for your returns.

trades.fitness.capabilities.8.body.message: Send a waiver and a health questionnaire before the first session, and keep the signed copies with the client.

trades.fitness.capabilities.9.body.message: Clients get a reminder before each session and class. Replies, cancellations and questions arrive in one inbox.

trades.fitness.capabilities.10.body.message: Sell protein, bands and water bottles at the desk or from your shop page for pickup, with stock counts that drop as you sell.

trades.fitness.capabilities.11.body.message: Run the studio from a laptop at the desk and your phone on the floor. The schedule stays on the device when the signal is weak.

trades.fitness.pay.title.message: A ten-session pack, with GST and QST worked out.

trades.fitness.pay.body.message: The pack is sold once and counts down with each session. The invoice shows GST and QST on separate lines, and both amounts are tracked by period for your federal and Quebec returns.

trades.cleaning.oneLine.message: Recurring cleans, each home's entry notes, and the invoice when the job is done.

trades.cleaning.h1.message: Recurring cleans, the right address, and the invoice after each visit.

trades.cleaning.lede.message: Clients book a one-off or a regular clean online, the home and its entry notes are on every booking, and the invoice goes out when the job is marked done.

trades.cleaning.photo.alt.message: A cleaner wiping a white counter in a bright home

trades.cleaning.photo2.alt.message: A cleaner in rubber gloves wiping a table

trades.cleaning.bookings.title.message: Weekly, every two weeks, or once before a move.

trades.cleaning.bookings.body.message: Each home is stored on the client as a property, with the address, the number of rooms, pets in the house and how to get in. Recurring cleans repeat on their own, and each visit lands on the right cleaner's schedule with time for travel after it.

trades.cleaning.bookings.list.0.message: Properties with address and entry instructions

trades.cleaning.bookings.list.1.message: Recurring cleans weekly, every two weeks or monthly

trades.cleaning.bookings.list.2.message: Add-ons such as the inside of the oven or fridge

trades.cleaning.bookings.list.3.message: Buffers between jobs for travel time

trades.cleaning.capabilities.0.body.message: Take a deposit when a client books a deep clean or a move-out, and it is applied to the invoice when the job is done.

trades.cleaning.capabilities.1.body.message: Bill a regular clean as a monthly plan charged to a saved card, or invoice each visit, whichever suits the client.

trades.cleaning.capabilities.2.body.message: Send an estimate for a deep clean or a move-out. When the client accepts it, it becomes an invoice with the same lines.

trades.cleaning.capabilities.3.body.message: Clients pay the invoice by card from the link it arrives with, and the invoice is marked paid as soon as the payment goes through.

trades.cleaning.capabilities.4.title.message: Tap to Pay at the door

trades.cleaning.capabilities.4.body.message: If a client wants to pay in person, charge their card on your phone when you finish, without a separate card reader.

trades.cleaning.capabilities.5.body.message: Sell cleaning gift cards online, for example for new parents or a housewarming, and redeem them against any visit.

trades.cleaning.capabilities.6.body.message: Assign each job to a cleaner. Completed jobs are recorded as earnings, so pay records are ready at the end of the period.

trades.cleaning.capabilities.7.body.message: Cleaning services in Ontario carry 13% HST. It is added to every line and tracked by period, ready for your return.

trades.cleaning.capabilities.8.body.message: Clients get a reminder before each clean, and you can text them from the app when you are on the way.

trades.cleaning.capabilities.9.body.message: Save your Google review link to invite clients after completed appointments. Clients leave their reviews directly on Google.

trades.cleaning.capabilities.10.body.message: Add the booking page to your website with a short snippet, so new clients can choose a clean and a time without a phone call.

trades.cleaning.capabilities.11.body.message: The day's jobs, addresses and entry notes are stored on your phone, so they are there in a basement or a building with poor reception.

trades.cleaning.pay.title.message: A three-bedroom clean with an add-on, invoiced when it is done.

trades.cleaning.pay.body.message: When the cleaner marks the job done, the invoice goes to the client with Ontario HST added. The client pays by card from the invoice link, and the invoice is marked paid when the payment goes through.

trades.tutoring.oneLine.message: Weekly lessons, students under a parent's account, and term packages.

trades.tutoring.h1.message: Lessons, terms and families, organised around each student.

trades.tutoring.lede.message: A parent's account holds each of their children, lessons repeat weekly through the term, and packages or monthly plans are billed to the card on file.

trades.tutoring.photo.alt.message: A teacher guiding a young student through a keyboard lesson

trades.tutoring.photo2.alt.message: A music teacher seated beside a student at a keyboard

trades.tutoring.bookings.title.message: The same time every week, until the term ends.

trades.tutoring.bookings.body.message: Book a weekly lesson once and it repeats until the date you set. Each lesson is tied to the student, so a parent with two children sees both schedules on one account and pays one bill. Small group classes take bookings up to the number of seats you set.

trades.tutoring.bookings.list.0.message: Students stored under the parent's account

trades.tutoring.bookings.list.1.message: Weekly lessons with an end date

trades.tutoring.bookings.list.2.message: Group classes with a seat limit

trades.tutoring.bookings.list.3.message: Notes on each lesson for the next tutor

trades.tutoring.capabilities.0.body.message: Sell a term of ten lessons up front. Each lesson counts against the package, and you can see how many are left on the student's record.

trades.tutoring.capabilities.1.body.message: Charge a monthly lesson plan to a saved card or by pre-authorized debit, and pause it over the summer.

trades.tutoring.capabilities.2.body.message: Lessons for every child on the account are invoiced to the parent, who pays by card from the invoice link.

trades.tutoring.capabilities.3.body.message: Hold a seat in a class or a regular weekly time with a deposit, which is applied to the first invoice.

trades.tutoring.capabilities.4.body.message: Sell gift cards for lessons, for example as a birthday present from a grandparent, and redeem them against any lesson or package.

trades.tutoring.capabilities.5.body.message: Each tutor has their own subjects, hours and students. Completed lessons are recorded as earnings, and T4A reports are ready at year end.

trades.tutoring.capabilities.6.body.message: Some tutoring is exempt from GST/HST and some lessons are not. Each invoice line can be marked as taxable or not, so you can follow your accountant's advice.

trades.tutoring.capabilities.7.body.message: Collect contact details, allergies and photo consent at registration, signed online and kept with the student.

trades.tutoring.capabilities.8.body.message: Reminders go to the parent by text before each lesson, and cancellations come back to one inbox.

trades.tutoring.capabilities.9.body.message: Save your Google review link to invite clients after completed appointments. Clients leave their reviews directly on Google.

trades.tutoring.capabilities.10.body.message: Add the booking page to your website so families can pick a subject, a tutor and a weekly time.

trades.tutoring.capabilities.11.body.message: Check the afternoon's lessons on your phone between students. The schedule is stored on the device and syncs when you are online.

trades.tutoring.pay.title.message: One family, two students, one account.

trades.tutoring.pay.body.message: Daniel and Ruth are both on their mother's account. Each lesson is booked for the right child, the term package counts down as lessons are taught, and the parent receives one invoice for both.

trades.wellness.oneLine.message: Practitioners, intake forms and treatment packages.

trades.wellness.h1.message: Treatments and intake forms, booked together.

trades.wellness.lede.message: Each booking shows the practitioner and the treatment, new clients fill in their intake form before the first visit, and every paid visit ends with a receipt by text.

trades.wellness.photo.alt.message: A massage therapist working on a client's shoulder beside a large window

trades.wellness.photo2.alt.message: Two therapists working in a bright treatment room

trades.wellness.bookings.title.message: Each practitioner has their own column on the schedule.

trades.wellness.bookings.body.message: Each practitioner has their own hours and treatments, and each booking shows who it is with. Treatments of different lengths are separate services with their own price, and a buffer after each one leaves time to turn the room over.

trades.wellness.bookings.list.2.message: Hours and days off for each practitioner

trades.wellness.capabilities.0.body.message: Send the health intake form when a new client books. It is signed online and kept on their record for the next visit.

trades.wellness.capabilities.1.body.message: Sell a package of five or ten treatments that counts down as they are used, with an expiry date if you set one.

trades.wellness.capabilities.2.body.message: Charge a monthly membership that includes a treatment to a saved card or by pre-authorized debit.

trades.wellness.capabilities.3.body.message: Take a deposit when a new client books, and it is applied to the invoice for that treatment.

trades.wellness.capabilities.4.body.message: Every paid visit sends a receipt with the treatment, the date and the amount, so clients have it for their records.

trades.wellness.capabilities.5.body.message: Take payment in the treatment room with Tap to Pay, or let the client pay from the link in their invoice.

trades.wellness.capabilities.6.body.message: Gift cards are sold online and at the front desk, and redeemed against any treatment or package.

trades.wellness.capabilities.7.body.message: Each practitioner has their own hours and treatments. Completed treatments are recorded as earnings for their pay.

trades.wellness.capabilities.8.body.message: GST, HST, PST or QST is worked out from your province, and a line can be marked as not taxable where a service is exempt. Your accountant can tell you which apply.

trades.wellness.capabilities.9.body.message: Clients get a reminder before each visit, and messages come back to one inbox, separate from your personal phone.

trades.wellness.capabilities.10.body.message: Save your Google review link to invite clients after completed appointments. Clients leave their reviews directly on Google.

trades.wellness.capabilities.11.body.message: Sell massage oils and heat packs at checkout, or let clients add one when they book so it is on the visit's invoice.

trades.wellness.pay.title.message: A new client's first visit, from intake form to receipt.

trades.wellness.pay.body.message: Helen booked online and received the intake form with her confirmation. She signed it before the visit, and her record now holds the form, the package she bought and her next appointment.

trades.wellness.record.detail.message: Client since October · card on file

trades.photography.oneLine.message: Estimates, signed contracts, retainers and bookable mini sessions.

trades.photography.h1.message: Enquiries become estimates, contracts and booked sessions.

trades.photography.lede.message: Send an estimate for a session or an event, have the client sign your contract and pay a retainer online, and invoice the balance before delivery.

trades.photography.photo.alt.message: A photographer checking his camera in a daylight studio

trades.photography.photo2.alt.message: A photographer taking a portrait in a daylight studio

trades.photography.bookings.title.message: Mini sessions on the booking page, larger work by estimate.

trades.photography.bookings.body.message: Short portrait or mini sessions are booked straight from your booking page in fixed time slots, with a deposit to hold the slot. Weddings, events and commercial work start as an estimate, and the date is booked once the client accepts and pays the retainer.

trades.photography.bookings.list.2.message: Retainers as a fixed amount or a percentage

trades.photography.bookings.list.3.message: Buffers before and after on-location shoots

trades.photography.capabilities.0.body.message: Send an estimate with the coverage, hours and prints listed. When the client accepts it, it becomes an invoice with the same lines.

trades.photography.capabilities.1.body.message: Attach your contract to the booking. The client signs it online, and the signed copy is kept on their record.

trades.photography.capabilities.2.body.message: Take a retainer as a fixed amount or a percentage when the client accepts. It is applied to the final invoice.

trades.photography.capabilities.3.body.message: Invoice the balance before delivery or on the event date, and see at a glance which invoices are still outstanding.

trades.photography.capabilities.4.body.message: Clients pay from the invoice link by card, and each payment is recorded against its invoice.

trades.photography.capabilities.5.body.message: Sell gift cards for a family or portrait session, and redeem them when the session is booked.

trades.photography.capabilities.6.body.message: Add second shooters and assistants as staff, with their own hours and earnings for each job.

trades.photography.capabilities.7.body.message: Photography services and prints in Ontario carry 13% HST, calculated on every line and tracked for your return.

trades.photography.capabilities.8.body.message: Keep timings, locations and questions in one message thread per client, by text.

trades.photography.capabilities.9.body.message: Save your Google review link to invite clients after completed appointments. Clients leave their reviews directly on Google.

trades.photography.capabilities.10.body.message: Embed your mini-session page on your portfolio site, so clients can pick a slot and pay the deposit there.

trades.photography.capabilities.11.body.message: Your day's sessions, addresses and client notes stay on your phone at locations with no reception.

trades.photography.pay.title.message: An accepted estimate with a retainer paid.

trades.photography.pay.body.message: The client accepted the estimate and paid a 30% retainer online when they signed the contract. The balance is invoiced before the gallery is delivered, with Ontario HST on every line.

trades.trades.oneLine.message: On-site estimates, scheduled jobs, and Tap to Pay when the work is done.

trades.trades.h1.message: Estimates on site, jobs on the calendar, and payment at the door.

trades.trades.lede.message: Quote the job from your phone, book it when the client accepts, and take payment with Tap to Pay when the work is done. The property and its notes are on every job.

trades.trades.photo.alt.message: A tradesperson in a paint-spattered apron restoring a window frame on trestles

trades.trades.photo2.alt.message: A tradesperson fitting a window frame with a cordless drill

trades.trades.heroCard.detail.message: Mike Turner · 3.5 h labour plus parts

trades.trades.bookings.title.message: Service calls online, larger jobs by estimate.

trades.trades.bookings.body.message: Clients book a fixed-length service call or an assessment visit online. Larger jobs start as an estimate with labour and materials on separate lines, and the job is scheduled once the client accepts.

trades.trades.bookings.list.0.message: Service calls with a fixed length

trades.trades.bookings.list.1.message: Properties with the address and access notes

trades.trades.bookings.list.3.message: Repeat maintenance visits, such as every six months

trades.trades.capabilities.0.body.message: Write the estimate on site with labour and materials on separate lines. When the client accepts it, it becomes the invoice.

trades.trades.capabilities.1.body.message: Take a deposit before you order materials, and it comes off the final invoice.

trades.trades.capabilities.2.title.message: Labour and materials on one invoice

trades.trades.capabilities.2.body.message: Hours, parts and materials each have their own line, and GST is added for your province.

trades.trades.capabilities.3.title.message: Tap to Pay at the door

trades.trades.capabilities.3.body.message: Charge a card on your iPhone or Android phone when the job is done, without carrying a separate card reader.

trades.trades.capabilities.4.title.message: Card payments from the invoice link

trades.trades.capabilities.4.body.message: Clients who are not there when the job is done pay the invoice by card from its link, and the payment is recorded against it.

trades.trades.capabilities.5.body.message: Sell gift cards for a service call or a set amount, and redeem them against any job.

trades.trades.capabilities.6.body.message: Assign jobs to your helpers. Their completed work is recorded as earnings, and T4A reports are ready at year end.

trades.trades.capabilities.7.body.message: Alberta has no provincial sales tax, so services carry 5% GST, calculated on every line and tracked by period for your return.

trades.trades.capabilities.8.body.message: Clients get a reminder the day before, and you can text them from the app when you are on the way.

trades.trades.capabilities.9.body.message: Save your Google review link to invite clients after completed appointments. Clients leave their reviews directly on Google.

trades.trades.capabilities.10.body.message: Add the booking page to your website so new clients can book a service call without phoning.

trades.trades.capabilities.11.body.message: Job notes and the day's addresses stay on your phone in basements and crawl spaces, and sync when you are back online.

trades.trades.pay.title.message: Labour and parts, paid when the job is done.

trades.trades.pay.body.message: The client paid a deposit when they accepted the estimate. When the work is done, the invoice applies it, adds GST, and the client taps their card on your phone for the balance.

site.jsonLd.description.message: Booking, invoices, payments and sales tax for service businesses in Canada.

pages.paymentsPage.meta.description.message: Card payments online and Tap to Pay in person, recorded against each invoice, paid out to your bank, with the sales tax set aside for your return.

pages.paymentsPage.title.message: Get paid in person and online, straight to your bank.

pages.paymentsPage.lede.message: Clients pay by card from an invoice link, when they book, or with Tap to Pay at the counter. Each payment is recorded against its invoice and paid out to your bank, and its sales tax is set aside for your return.

pages.paymentsPage.bands.0.title.message: Tap to Pay at the counter, on the phone you already have.

pages.paymentsPage.bands.0.body.message: Tap to Pay turns an iPhone or Android phone into a card reader. Charge for a visit or sell products, gift cards and packages, and the receipt goes out by text.

pages.paymentsPage.bands.0.points.0.message: Tap to Pay on iPhone and Android

pages.paymentsPage.bands.0.points.1.message: Visits, products and gift cards on one sale

pages.paymentsPage.bands.1.title.message: Every invoice carries a link the client can pay from.

pages.paymentsPage.bands.1.body.message: Send an invoice and the client pays it by card from the link, or ask for a deposit when they book online. Partial payments, refunds and credit notes are recorded on the same invoice.

pages.paymentsPage.bands.1.points.0.message: Card payment from a link on every invoice

pages.paymentsPage.bands.1.points.1.message: Deposits taken at booking and applied to the invoice

pages.paymentsPage.bands.1.points.2.message: Pre-authorized debit for clients who prefer it

pages.paymentsPage.closing.title.message: Get paid the way your clients want to pay.

pages.paymentsPage.closing.lede.message: Set up card payments and payouts in the app, then send your first invoice or open your booking page.

pages.contactPage.meta.description.message: Send a question to the Clientbridge team about the product, pricing or getting your business set up.

pages.contactPage.lede.message: Questions about Clientbridge, pricing or getting your business set up? Send us a note and we'll reply by email.

pages.contactPage.honeypot.description: The label of a field hidden from people, which only spam bots fill in.

pages.contactPage.consent.message: We use what you send only to answer you.

pages.contactPage.retry.message: We couldn't send your message. Check your email address and try again.

pages.contactPage.reach.message: You can also write to {email}, or by mail to {address}.

pages.contactPage.thanks.meta.descriptio.message: Thanks for writing to Clientbridge. We'll reply to the email address you gave us.

pages.contactPage.thanks.title.message: Thanks, your message is on its way.

pages.contactPage.thanks.body.message: We'll reply to the email address you gave us. Until then, you can look through what Clientbridge does and what it costs.
